variants.name: 1 kg
variants.about_this_item:
• High-quality grain and seed mixture for parrots
  • Classic mixture with a lot of grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: striped sunflower seeds, white sunflower seeds, cribs maize, peeled peanuts, wheat, buckwheat, pointed oats, peeled oats, safflower, paddy rice, milo, whole peanuts, cedar nuts, popcorn, pumpkin kernels.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 14%, crude fat 21.3%, crude fibre 16.5%, crude ash 2.6%, calcium 0.14%, phosphorus 0.331%, lysine 0.46%, methionine 0.25%, threonine 0.45%.
variants.feeding_instructions: Your birds stay in top condition when they regularly get a supplement of egg food, vitamins and/or minerals. Refresh feed and drinking water in time.
